pr_title: [wasm] Throw exception if culture data does not exist in icu
pr_body:
Fix #47068 
Fix #46327

Throw exception if culture data doesn't exist. Currently defaults to `en-us`.

Fix #47068 Fix #46327 Throw exception if culture data doesn't exist. Currently defaults to `en-us`.
Author: tqiu8
Assignees: -
Labels: `area-System.Globalization`
Milestone: -

Could you please replace the checks in 

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/f1ad1b97e9387dc700bf72917f29fc7d1258ac1a/src/libraries/System.Private.CoreLib/src/System/Globalization/CultureInfo.Nls.cs#L14
and 
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/f1ad1b97e9387dc700bf72917f29fc7d1258ac1a/src/libraries/System.Private.CoreLib/src/System/Globalization/CultureInfo.Icu.cs#L14

with the new introduced method calls?

thank you!

One last ask, could you please add a new test (not specific to the browser) to test the new environment variable? here is some test example which doing similar idea (testing setting environment variable). 

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/e63969dba515a40d35a7a2f993b7d3434cf56a06/src/libraries/System.Threading.Tasks.Extensions/tests/AsyncValueTaskMethodBuilderTests.cs#L568

> You need to do this test with RemoteExecutor as I pointed before in my comment [#47301 (comment)](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/47301#issuecomment-765774690). Otherwise this test can easily fail and also will cause other problems for other tests running after it.

I don't think RemoteExcutor or System.Diagnostics.Process are supported on wasm right now. I'm going to store the current env var and reset it back to that after the test?

> I don't think RemoteExcutor or System.Diagnostics.Process are supported on wasm right now. I'm going to store the current env var and reset it back to that after the test?

Yes, just exclude the added test from running on WASM. just mark the test with the attribute `[ConditionalFact(typeof(RemoteExecutor), nameof(RemoteExecutor.IsSupported))]`

> I think you have changed these other tests because of your added test. If you fix your added test, you will not need to change these tests any more. please revert the changes in these existing tests. Thanks.

Those tests were failing on CI before my last commit. Some of the locales in the test data are not supported on wasm.

> Those tests were failing on CI before my last commit. Some of the locales in the test data are not supported on wasm.

I would say exclude these locales from the list when running on WASM instead of changing the code. I assume we already have a way at runtime to check if we are running in WASM. right?

> I would say exclude these locales from the list when running on WASM instead of changing the code. I assume we already have a way at runtime to check if we are running in WASM. right?

There are a lot more unsupported locales for WASM than there are supported...would catching the CultureNotFoundException cause bad tests to pass?

@tqiu8 thanks a lot for addressing my feedback. I just added some minor comments but otherwise LGTM. 

I'll let @lewing and @marek-safar take a final look to judge the changes for wasm,

> @tqiu8 thanks a lot for addressing my feedback. I just added some minor comments but otherwise LGTM.
> 
> I'll let @lewing and @marek-safar take a final look to judge the changes for wasm,

Thank you!
